description: This is a Python script for ingesting files from a specified folder, with support for watching for changes, ignoring certain files, and logging. It defines a LocalIngestWorker class that manages file validation, ingestion, and watching, utilizing external services like IngestService and IngestWatcher.

classes.name: LocalIngestWorker
classes.description: Handles file validation, ingestion, and watching for a specific folder, using provided ingestion service and settings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the worker with ingestion service and settings, setting up internal state.

methods.name: _validate_folder
methods.description: Checks if a folder is allowed for ingestion based on settings.

methods.name: _find_all_files_in_folder
methods.description: Recursively searches for files in a folder, counting and validating them.

methods.name: ingest_folder
methods.description: Counts and ingests all files in a folder, respecting ignored files.

methods.name: _ingest_all
methods.description: Performs bulk ingestion of a list of files.

methods.name: ingest_on_watch
methods.description: Handles file change events for ingestion.

methods.name: _do_ingest_one
methods.description: Ingests a single file if it exists, with error handling.
